drills.situation_es: Preséntate y di que tienes 28 años
drills.en: I'm twenty-eight years old.
alt: I am twenty-eight years old.
I'm 28 years old.
I am 28.
drills.trap_es: En inglés la edad se 'es' (I am), nunca se 'tiene' (evita decir 'I have 28 years').

drills.situation_es: Dile a tu compañero que estás de acuerdo con él
drills.en: I totally agree with you.
alt: I agree with you.
I completely agree with you.
drills.trap_es: 'Agree' ya es un verbo, no lleva 'am'. Evita 'I am agree'.

drills.situation_es: Di que tienes que trabajar temprano mañana
drills.en: I have to work early tomorrow.
alt: I have to go to work early tomorrow.
I need to work early tomorrow.
drills.trap_es: Recuerda decir 'have to' (tener que), no solo 'have work'.

drills.situation_es: Di que hace mucho calor hoy
drills.en: It's really hot today.
alt: It is very hot today.
It's very hot today.
drills.trap_es: El inglés siempre necesita sujeto ('It's'), no digas 'Is hot' ni 'Makes hot'.

drills.situation_es: Pide un café con leche amablemente en una cafetería
drills.en: Can I have a coffee with milk, please?
alt: Could I have a coffee with milk, please?
I'd like a coffee with milk, please.
drills.trap_es: Para pedir en tiendas usa 'Can I have...?' o 'I'd like...', no 'Give me'.

drills.situation_es: Pide a alguien que hable más despacio porque no entiendes
drills.en: Sorry, I don't understand. Can you speak slower?
alt: I don't understand. Could you speak more slowly?
Sorry, I didn't understand.
drills.trap_es: En presente negativo usa 'don't', nunca 'I no understand'.
drills.connected: don't understand → la 't' de don't casi desaparece

drills.situation_es: Pregunta cuánto cuesta esta camisa
drills.en: Excuse me, how much is this shirt?
alt: How much is this shirt?
How much does this shirt cost?
drills.trap_es: Para precios singulares usa 'How much is...', no 'How many cost?'.

drills.situation_es: Di que hay dos supermercados cerca de tu casa
drills.en: There are two supermarkets near my house.
alt: There are two supermarkets close to my house.
There are two grocery stores near my home.
drills.trap_es: 'Hay' en inglés es 'There is' (singular) o 'There are' (plural), nunca 'Have two supermarkets'.

drills.situation_es: Di que vas a estudiar inglés esta noche
drills.en: I'm going to study English tonight.
alt: I'm gonna study English tonight.
I am going to study English tonight.
drills.trap_es: Para planes inmediatos usa 'going to + verbo' (no olvides el 'to').

drills.situation_es: Despídete diciendo que nos vemos el lunes por la mañana
drills.en: See you on Monday morning!
alt: See you Monday morning.
I'll see you on Monday morning.
drills.trap_es: Los días de la semana llevan 'on' (on Monday), nunca 'the Monday'.

drills.situation_es: Di que quieres practicar inglés todos los días
drills.en: I want to practice English every day.
alt: I wanna practice English every day.
I want to practise English every day.
drills.trap_es: Después de 'want' va 'to + verbo' sin -ing (evita 'I want practice' o 'I want practicing').

drills.situation_es: Dile a un amigo que te espere cinco minutos
drills.en: Wait for me five minutes, please.
alt: Wait for me for five minutes.
Please wait five minutes for me.
drills.trap_es: En inglés esperas 'por' alguien: 'wait for me', no 'wait me'.

drills.situation_es: Pregúntale a alguien si vio la película anoche
drills.en: Did you watch the movie last night?
alt: Did you see the movie last night?
Did you watch that movie last night?
drills.trap_es: Cuando usas 'Did', el verbo va en forma base ('watch'), nunca en pasado ('watched').

drills.situation_es: Responde que depende del clima y de tu horario
drills.en: It depends on the weather and my schedule.
alt: Well, it depends on the weather and my schedule.
drills.trap_es: 'Depend' siempre va con 'on' ('depends on'), nunca con 'of' ('depends of').

drills.situation_es: Avísale a tu jefe que llegarás 10 minutos tarde por el tráfico
drills.en: I'm running ten minutes late because of traffic.
alt: I'll be ten minutes late because of the traffic.
I am ten minutes late due to traffic.
drills.trap_es: 'Arrive late' suena robótico en mensajes rápidos; los nativos dicen 'running late' o 'be late'.

drills.situation_es: Dile a tu colega que te diga la verdad
drills.en: Please tell me the truth.
alt: Tell me the truth, please.
drills.trap_es: Cuando mencionas a quién hablas usa 'tell me', no 'say me'.

drills.situation_es: Pregunta cuánto tiempo toma llegar al aeropuerto
drills.en: How long does it take to get to the airport?
alt: How long does it take to reach the airport?
drills.trap_es: Para duración de viajes usa 'How long does it take?', no 'How much time takes?'.

drills.situation_es: Di que se te olvidó enviar el correo electrónico ayer
drills.en: I forgot to send the email yesterday.
alt: I completely forgot to send the email yesterday.
drills.trap_es: Se dice 'I forgot to...', no 'It forgot me' ni 'I forgot send'.

drills.situation_es: Di que tienes muchas ganas de ver a tu familia
drills.en: I'm looking forward to seeing my family.
alt: I'm really looking forward to seeing my family.
drills.trap_es: Después de 'look forward to', el verbo lleva '-ing' ('seeing'), no infinitivo ('see').

drills.situation_es: Di que cometiste un error pero lo vas a arreglar
drills.en: I made a mistake, but I'll fix it.
alt: I made a mistake, but I will fix it.
drills.trap_es: Los errores se 'hacen' con 'make' (make a mistake), nunca 'do a mistake'.

drills.situation_es: Di que ya estás acostumbrado a levantarte temprano
drills.en: I'm used to waking up early now.
alt: I am used to getting up early now.
I'm used to waking up early.
drills.trap_es: 'Used to + verbo' es pasado ('solía'). 'Be used to + -ing' significa 'estar acostumbrado a'.

drills.situation_es: Pregunta con cortesía dónde está la estación de metro más cercana
drills.en: Could you tell me where the nearest subway station is?
alt: Do you know where the nearest subway station is?
Could you tell me where the closest metro station is?
drills.trap_es: En preguntas indirectas ('Could you tell me where...'), el verbo 'is' va AL FINAL, no 'where is the station'.

drills.situation_es: Di que llevas dos años estudiando inglés
drills.en: I've been studying English for two years.
alt: I have been learning English for two years.
drills.trap_es: Para algo que empezó en el pasado y continúa hoy, usa 'I've been + -ing', no 'I study since two years'.

drills.situation_es: Pide amablemente a alguien si le importaría abrir la ventana
drills.en: Would you mind opening the window?
alt: Would you mind opening that window, please?
drills.trap_es: Después de 'Would you mind' el verbo siempre lleva '-ing', nunca 'to open'.

drills.situation_es: Expresa un contraste: trabajar desde casa ahorra tiempo, pero por otro lado te sientes solo
drills.en: Working from home saves time, but on the other hand it can feel lonely.
alt: Working from home saves time, on the other hand it feels lonely.
drills.trap_es: Usa 'on the other hand' para contrastar ideas; evita traducir literalmente 'by other side'.

drills.situation_es: Aclara amablemente que en realidad vives en otra ciudad
drills.en: Actually, I live in another city now.
alt: Actually, I currently live in a different city.
drills.trap_es: 'Actually' significa 'en realidad / de hecho', NO 'actualmente' (eso es 'currently').

drills.situation_es: Di que deberías haber traído una chaqueta porque hace frío
drills.en: I should have brought a jacket.
alt: I should've brought a jacket.
I should have brought a coat.
drills.trap_es: Para arrepentimiento en el pasado usa 'should have + participio', no 'I should bring yesterday'.

drills.situation_es: Recuérdale a tu amigo que se asegure de cerrar la puerta con llave
drills.en: Make sure you lock the door before you leave.
alt: Make sure to lock the door before leaving.
drills.trap_es: Di 'Make sure you lock...', no 'Make sure of lock'.

drills.situation_es: Recomienda un restaurante diciendo que vale la pena probarlo
drills.en: That restaurant is definitely worth trying.
alt: It's definitely worth trying that restaurant.
drills.trap_es: Después de 'worth' siempre va '-ing' ('worth trying'), nunca 'worth to try'.

drills.chunk: Let me get back to you
drills.situation_es: Di en una reunión que vas a revisarlo y les respondes luego
drills.en: Let me check that and get back to you.
alt: Let me look into it and get back to you.
drills.trap_es: Frase de oro en oficinas: 'get back to you' es mucho más natural que 'I respond you later'.

drills.situation_es: Expresa arrepentimiento por no haber empezado a aprender antes
drills.en: I wish I had started learning earlier.
alt: I wish I'd started learning earlier.
drills.trap_es: Para deseos sobre el pasado usa 'I wish I had + participio', no 'I wish I started'.

drills.situation_es: Di en una discusión que alguien mencionó un punto muy válido
drills.en: She brought up a really valid point during the meeting.
alt: She pointed out a very valid point in the meeting.
drills.trap_es: Usa 'bring up a point' (sacar un tema) en vez de 'put a point'.

drills.situation_es: Di que fuiste a trabajar a pesar de sentirte cansado
drills.en: Even though I felt tired, I still went to work.
alt: Despite feeling tired, I still went to work.
Although I was tired, I went to work.
drills.trap_es: 'Despite' nunca lleva 'of' (no digas 'despite of'). Con 'Even though' va sujeto + verbo.

drills.situation_es: Di educadamente que no terminas de entender la explicación de alguien
drills.en: I'm not quite sure I follow what you mean.
alt: Could you clarify what you mean by that?
I'm not sure I follow.
drills.trap_es: Forma profesional de pedir aclaración sin sonar brusco como 'I don't understand you'.

drills.situation_es: Cuenta que al final resultó que vivían en el mismo barrio
drills.en: It turns out we actually live in the same neighborhood.
alt: It turned out that we lived in the same neighborhood.
drills.trap_es: 'Resultó que' se dice 'It turns out / It turned out', no 'It resulted that'.

drills.situation_es: Evalúa un proyecto diciendo que en términos de costos funciona muy bien
drills.en: In terms of cost, this option makes the most sense.
alt: In terms of budget, this option works best.
drills.trap_es: 'Makes sense' (tiene sentido) siempre usa 'make', nunca 'has sense'.

drills.situation_es: Cuenta que al final terminaste quedándote en casa viendo una serie
drills.en: I ended up staying home and watching a show.
alt: We ended up staying at home all evening.
drills.trap_es: 'End up' siempre va seguido de '-ing' ('ended up staying'), no 'ended up to stay'.

drills.situation_es: Di que preferirías posponer la llamada para mañana
drills.en: I'd rather push the call to tomorrow.
alt: I would rather move the call to tomorrow.
drills.trap_es: 'I'd rather' va directo al verbo sin 'to' (nunca 'I'd rather to push').

drills.situation_es: Anima a un compañero diciendo que pronto le agarrará el truco
drills.en: Don't worry, you'll get the hang of it soon.
alt: Give it a few days and you'll get the hang of it.
drills.trap_es: Expresión idiomática clave para 'agarrarle la onda / el truco' a algo nuevo.

drills.situation_es: Di que se suponía que el paquete llegaría esta mañana
drills.en: The package was supposed to arrive this morning.
alt: That delivery was supposed to get here this morning.
drills.trap_es: Siempre es 'be supposed to' (con -d al final), aunque la 'd' casi no se pronuncie.

drills.situation_es: Di formalmente que si hubieras sabido el problema antes, habrías actuado distinto
drills.en: Had I known earlier, I would have handled it differently.
alt: If I had known earlier, I would've handled it differently.
drills.trap_es: Inversión elegante de tercer condicional: omite 'If' e invierte 'Had I known'.

drills.situation_es: Pide en una junta que tengan en cuenta las limitaciones de tiempo
drills.en: We need to take the time constraints into account.
alt: We should take the tight deadline into account.
drills.trap_es: Usa 'take into account' o 'keep in mind'; evita 'have in count'.

drills.situation_es: Destaca que el plan no solo ahorra dinero sino que también mejora la calidad
drills.en: Not only does it save money, but it also improves quality.
alt: This plan not only saves money, it also improves quality.
drills.trap_es: Si empiezas la frase con 'Not only', debes invertir el auxiliar ('Not only does it...').

drills.chunk: Off the top of my head
drills.situation_es: Di que no recuerdas la cifra exacta de memoria, pero puedes buscarla
drills.en: Off the top of my head, I don't know the exact number.
alt: I can't recall the exact figure off the top of my head.
drills.trap_es: Modismo naturalísimo para decir 'de memoria / así de pronto' sin sonar traducido.

drills.situation_es: Resume un problema complejo diciendo que todo se reduce a la comunicación
drills.en: At the end of the day, it all boils down to communication.
alt: Ultimately, it comes down to good communication.
drills.trap_es: 'Boils down to' o 'comes down to' significa 'se reduce a' en inglés ejecutivo.

drills.situation_es: Propón ver cómo avanza la tarde antes de confirmar los planes
drills.en: Let's play it by ear and decide later this afternoon.
alt: Let's just play it by ear depending on how things go.
drills.trap_es: 'Play it by ear' significa improvisar según vayan saliendo las cosas.

drills.situation_es: Confirma que todo el equipo entiende el objetivo de la misma manera
drills.en: I just want to make sure we're all on the same page.
alt: Let's double-check that everyone is on the same page.
drills.trap_es: Mucho más natural en trabajo que 'make sure we agree in the same thing'.

drills.situation_es: Di con énfasis que ya es hora de actualizar el sistema
drills.en: It's high time we updated our system.
alt: It's about time we upgraded our system.
drills.trap_es: Después de 'It's high time / about time', el verbo va en PASADO ('updated'), aunque hables del presente.

drills.situation_es: Propón ir cerrando la reunión porque ya se acabó el tiempo
drills.en: Let's wrap things up and follow up via email.
alt: We should wrap up this meeting now.
drills.trap_es: 'Wrap up' es cerrar una reunión o tarea; 'follow up' es dar seguimiento.

drills.situation_es: Señala diplomáticamente que hay que tener presente el riesgo
drills.en: We ought to bear in mind that the timeline is quite tight.
alt: Please keep in mind that the deadline is very tight.
drills.trap_es: 'Bear in mind' / 'keep in mind' son las formas naturales de decir 'tener en cuenta'.
